name: Carbon Design System
takeaways: Use opaque layers and productive motion.
Keep dense data connected rather than carded.
risks: Carbon defaults can feel corporate if copied literally.

name: Primer
takeaways: Use redundant chart encodings and direct labels.
risks: GitHub visual identity must not be copied.

name: Atlassian Design System
takeaways: Pair status colors with words and icons.
risks: Component styling is visually heavier than Black Vector.

name: GOV.UK Design System
takeaways: Make keyboard focus impossible to miss.
Put error text next to the field and explain recovery.
risks: Brand typography and colors are not a product fit.

name: Adobe Spectrum
takeaways: Differentiate loading, indeterminate, and known progress.
risks: Broad system would compete with project tokens.

name: Shopify Polaris
takeaways: Keep order and checkout state explicit.
risks: Polaris brand language should not enter MyShop.

name: GitLab Pajamas
takeaways: Use concise operational empty states with one next action.
risks: Illustration style is not part of Black Vector.

name: WAI-ARIA APG
risks: APG is behavior guidance, not visual direction.
